common_rerun_rules: Keep every current original FAIL/ERROR and unexecuted portion until an actual superseding accepted execution exists. Manual review and local-corrected results are not automatic PASS or certification.

For a CSA question, record the accepted interpretation, corrected official test/helper version or verified relevant SDK aggregation behavior before repeating. Unchanged prerequisites, an unrelated rebuild or old independent PASS alone do not justify a long repeat.

For an owner/laboratory prerequisite, supply the actual authorized identity, physical artifact, radio/network bench or DUT-originated trigger. Do not substitute simulated physical work, a borrowed VID, SDK-only flag or a controller request pretending to originate at DUT.

Freeze exact case/endpoint/collection, binary/source/test/helper/PICS fingerprints and isolated stores. If capabilities genuinely change, review a new coherent profile; do not hide a failure through ad-hoc PICS edits.

On an attributed native change, reproduce the real defect, make the smallest shared repair, rerun the original accepted procedure and complete relevant full Linux Memcheck followed by separate ASan/UBSan/LSan and error/recovery checks. Reuse proven binaries only with verified identity and explicit coverage limits for tester-only work.

Use a bounded first-error/packet/state capture and retain run/process identity. Do not submit duplicates while RUNNING, accelerate required timeouts, discard setup attempts or interrupt shared VM/SSH interfaces.

Keep the owner-deferred multi-hour TC-DGGEN-2.1 unscheduled until its controller/reset prerequisite and explicit owner execution window are supplied. Short diagnostic evidence cannot become its original full PASS.

After the changed prerequisite is verified, run the complete selected original procedure including previously unreached steps and real state readback. Then update one explicit classification delta, retain prior evidence and commit locally. Schedule the final stable applicable-matrix rerun after relevant repairs/gates are resolved.
next_action: Owner reviews/prioritizes this unsent package. Send or upload only after explicit authorization and selection of recipient/material. Until a gate changes, continue only independent work that adds coverage; do not restart already-attributed original failures. No automatic sending or long-run scheduling is configured.
